thread:
Alex (PM): Heads-up — customer ACME asked to surface per-route cost & error traces in the console for next sprint. Can we scope down a launchable surface? Need canary criteria by EOD.
Maria (SRE): +1. Short list: 1) per-route cost widget, 2) trace hook to link errors to token spans, 3) sample traces on error pages. Keep initial retention short (7d) to cut cost.
Sam (Eng): For trace hook: runtime can emit `trace_id` + `route` + `token_span` on error path. We can add a proxy-level tag. Estimate: 3 dev-weeks if we do full sampling + UI.
Li (Design): I can mock a compact panel that shows cost/day + top 3 error traces per route. Minimal — no full timeline. Will post PNGs.
Rebecca (Data): We'll need a join key. Suggest `route_id` + `model_variant`. Also propose sampling rate 1% by default with on-demand fetch for failures.
Alex (PM): Decision: aim for a "launch shelf" — minimal cost widget + single error trace link. Defer full sampling to M2. Acceptance: show cost delta, clickable trace, and SLA flag.
Sam (Eng): Agree. Technical ask: need schema for telemetry. Proposed event: `{"type":"obs.error","route_id":"...","trace_id":"...","span_start":int,"token_count":int,"model":"...","cost_usd":float}`
Maria (SRE): Also want fallback: if tracing disabled, surface aggregate error rate + last 5 logs. That keeps UI meaningful.
Li (Design): Will create two mocks: one for traced route, one for traced-disabled route.
Alex (PM): Canary plan: enable for 10% of routes for 48h in prod. KPI: reduce MTTI (mean time to investigate) by 30% on canary routes vs baseline. Need baseline.
Rebecca (Data): I'll compute baseline MTTI for last 30d. Will also add dashboard query snippet:
``
SELECT route_id, COUNT(*) as errors, AVG(time_to_first_ack) as avg_mtti
FROM errors
WHERE ts > now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY route_id
ORDER BY errors DESC
LIMIT 50;
```
Sam (Eng): OpsBot: triggered deploy to canary cluster.
OpsBot: deploy started for obs-canary v0.1 -> 1725554600
Maria (SRE): Quick note on cost: estimated ingest increase ~+12% for events; storage +3% with 7d retention. Optimize by batching and gzip. Sam will add batching.
Sam (Eng): I'll add batching + a small schema tweak to compress token_span to index. 2 days.
Alex (PM): Ok team — finalize mocks and schema by EOD. Rebecca + Maria send acceptance numbers tomorrow morning. Li, post mocks to thread. :thumbsup:
Li (Design): posted mock link: https://figma.com/file/ExampleMock
Rebecca (Data): baseline MTTI: 18m avg; I'll post per-route table tomorrow.
Alex (PM): thanks. Let's keep scope razor-thin.
